_meta.title: Reviewed Jupiter -> personal long transits
_meta.doctrine_source: Robert Hand, Planets in Transit (Jupiter sections; doctrine only, voiced original)
_meta.note: Jupiter expands the natal function; hard aspects carry the overreach/overindulgence shadow. Keyed transiting-Jupiter-first.

slots.recurring_opportunity_scene: Confidence and opportunity open up around who you are, and doors you'd stopped knocking on start to give
slots.trust_or_capacity_pattern: You can afford to aim higher than usual right now
slots.capacity_being_developed: What grows here is a bigger, more generous version of yourself that can hold the growth
slots.deliberate_participation: Say yes to the opportunity, sized to what you can actually honor
slots.pass_context: Because Jupiter's openings come in passes, take them as they arrive rather than all at once.
